decisions.reason: Manual J, Manual S, and Manual D are HVAC calculation methods and do not modify the existing requirement to perform necessary electrical calculations.
The HVAC calculation-method clarification does not change the existing electrical-drawing deliverable; message 25 already separately resolves its scope through the retained RESUME Event.
Specifying applicable HVAC calculation methods does not change the existing mechanical-drawing deliverable; its scope clarification is already represented by the same-message RESUME Event.
Manual J, Manual S, and Manual D concern HVAC calculations and do not alter the permit-ready plumbing-drawing requirement.
The source repeats that the electrical drawings will be stamped but does not change the endorsement requirement, endorsed documents, or required license jurisdiction.
